source_caption:
🎥🎬: MobLand (2025)

When a violent feud threatens to tear apart London’s criminal underworld, the Harrigan family turns to Harry Da Souza, their trusted fixer, to keep the situation under control. But as the conflict escalates, Harry discovers that the war is far more complicated than it first appeared.

Caught between rival gangsters and the demands of the Harrigan family, Harry uses his experience and connections to uncover betrayals before they can destroy the family’s empire. Meanwhile, shifting loyalties make it increasingly difficult to know who can be trusted.

As the violence intensifies, Harry is forced to make increasingly dangerous choices, proving that in the world of organized crime, survival often comes down to knowing when to strike—and when to betray the people closest to you.

source_details.synopsis: MobLand is a crime drama television series created by Ronan Bennett for Paramount+. The series stars Tom Hardy as Harry Da Souza, Pierce Brosnan as Conrad Harrigan and Helen Mirren as Maeve Harrigan. Additional main characters include Kevin Harrigan (Paddy Considine), Jan Da Souza (Joanne Froggatt), Isabella Harrigan (Lara Pulver), Eddie Harrigan (Anson Boon), and Seraphina Harrigan (Mandeep Dhillon). Guy Ritchie, Anthony Byrne, Daniel Syrkin, and Lawrence Gough serve as directors. Jez Butterworth and Bennett are credited with writing all ten episodes of the first season.
